title: Worker cooperative under the Unicorn Grocery rules (excerpt)
source: Rules of Unicorn Grocery Limited, rules 14-22, 32, 37, 47, 49, 53-55
name: LWGU
undertakings: Voluntary membership.  Orga does not make membership a condition of employment.
Education.  Orga tells those who may join what a member's role is, and trains its members in it.

14.mapped_to: admission is an act of the applicant and the directors; that the applicant is an employee is not checked
14.question: The app does not know who is an employee. Default: the directors judge it when they admit. Should someone attest employment?

15.mapped_to: undertaking of the organization; joining is always the applicant's own act

16.mapped_to: act: admit a member; decided by the directors rule
16.question: How the directors decide is in a part of the rules not given here. Used: more than half of all directors. Age and the one share are not checked. Agreed?

17.question: Should joining record these duties as the member's own promise? Default: not recorded.

19.mapped_to: carried by the same undertaking as rule 18

20.mapped_to: resigning is the member's own act (leave); expulsion is the act expel; the other three are not recorded
20.question: Who records that employment ended, that the share is no longer held, or a death? Default: nobody; the members may expel.

21.mapped_to: act: expel; decided by the extraordinary rule
21.question: The member must be heard before the vote. Default: the 14 days between the motion and the decision serve for it, and nothing checks that the member answered. Should the app require a recorded response?

22.mapped_to: payment for shares; re-admission by the members
22.question: Shares and their repayment are not built. Re-admission of an expelled member would need the app to remember the expulsion. Default: re-admission goes as any admission.

32.mapped_to: a motion can be decided only 14 days or more after it was moved
32.question: Shorter notice with the written agreement of 90% of the members is not built. Needed?

37.mapped_to: quorum on the votes: at least 33/50 of the members voted
37.question: The floor of 3 members is not built; it matters only below five members. Agreed to leave it out?

49.mapped_to: a tie does not decide: the threshold is more than half

53.mapped_to: the table of acts: expel and amend by the extraordinary rule, every other act by the ordinary rule
53.question: Disposing of a third of the assets and winding up have no act of their own here, so they go by the ordinary rule. Default kept; should they wait until such acts exist?

54.mapped_to: the extraordinary rule (at least three quarters of the votes cast) and the ordinary rule (more than half of the votes cast)
54.question: "Simple majority (51%)" is read as more than half. Agreed?

55.mapped_to: every vote in the app is a signed vote on a written motion
